sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Wordlist only (199 forms). Keraf's orthography uses acute accents for vowel quality (e = schwa vs e-acute = [e], e.g. ile-acute 'mountain' = /ile/, elen = /schwa-l-e~/), plus glottal stop and nasal vowels; no stress marking. The dissertation text itself (print, UI) could not be opened.

sources.note: Sec. 4.1.5 p.160: 'Until today, Eastern Lamaholot remains largely undescribed. The only materials available on Eastern Lamaholot are two 200 items wordlists collected by Keraf (1978a) of the varieties Lewoeleng and Lamatuka.'
